item_name: Rothco Dog Tag Bottle Opener With Chain
item_short_desc: Rothco's Dog Tag Bottle Opener with Chain is not your typical dog tag; it featured a cut out bottle opener made to remove the cap off of any standard beverage bottle. The Camo Dog Tag Opener is made from durable heat treated iron and hangs from a 24" neck chain.
